import pandas as pd

# File paths for the source CSV files
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_83/test_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_83/test_1.csv"

# Load Source 0
df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path)

# Rename Source 0 columns to match target schema suffix "_15"
df0_renamed = df0.rename(columns={
    'Happiness Rank': 'Happiness_Rank_15',
    'Happiness Score': 'Happiness_Score_15',
    'Standard Error': 'Standard_Error_15',
    'Economy (GDP per Capita)': 'Economy_15',
    'Family': 'Family_15',
    'Health (Life Expectancy)': 'Life_Expectancy_15',
    'Freedom': 'Freedom_15',
    'Trust (Government Corruption)': 'Trust_15',
    'Generosity': 'Generosity_15',
    'Dystopia Residual': 'Dystopia_15'
})

# Select only the columns needed from source 0
df0_selected = df0_renamed[[
    'Country', 'Region',
    'Happiness_Rank_15', 'Happiness_Score_15', 'Standard_Error_15',
    'Economy_15', 'Family_15', 'Life_Expectancy_15', 'Freedom_15',
    'Trust_15', 'Generosity_15', 'Dystopia_15'
]]

# Load Source 1
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path)

# Source 1 already has columns matching target schema suffix "_17" except "Region" is missing
# We will join on 'Country' and get 'Region' from df0

# Select relevant columns from source 1
df1_selected = df1[[
    'Country',
    'Happiness_Rank_17', 'Happiness_Score_17', 'Whisker_High_17', 'Whisker_Low_17',
    'Economy_17', 'Family_17', 'Life_Expectancy_17', 'Freedom_17',
    'Generosity_17', 'Trust_17', 'Dystopia_17'
]]

# Merge df0_selected and df1_selected on 'Country'
# This will bring in the 2015 data + Region and the 2017 data together
df_merged = pd.merge(df0_selected, df1_selected, on='Country', how='inner')

# The target schema columns in order:
target_columns = [
    'Country', 'Region',
    'Happiness_Rank_15', 'Happiness_Score_15', 'Standard_Error_15',
    'Economy_15', 'Family_15', 'Life_Expectancy_15', 'Freedom_15',
    'Trust_15', 'Generosity_15', 'Dystopia_15',
    'Happiness_Rank_17', 'Happiness_Score_17', 'Whisker_High_17', 'Whisker_Low_17',
    'Economy_17', 'Family_17', 'Life_Expectancy_17', 'Freedom_17',
    'Generosity_17', 'Trust_17', 'Dystopia_17'
]

# Reorder columns to match target schema
df_target = df_merged[target_columns]

# Ensure correct dtypes according to target schema
df_target = df_target.astype({
    'Country': 'string',
    'Region': 'string',
    'Happiness_Rank_15': 'Int64',
    'Happiness_Score_15': 'float',
    'Standard_Error_15': 'float',
    'Economy_15': 'float',
    'Family_15': 'float',
    'Life_Expectancy_15': 'float',
    'Freedom_15': 'float',
    'Trust_15': 'float',
    'Generosity_15': 'float',
    'Dystopia_15': 'float',
    'Happiness_Rank_17': 'Int64',
    'Happiness_Score_17': 'float',
    'Whisker_High_17': 'float',
    'Whisker_Low_17': 'float',
    'Economy_17': 'float',
    'Family_17': 'float',
    'Life_Expectancy_17': 'float',
    'Freedom_17': 'float',
    'Generosity_17': 'float',
    'Trust_17': 'float',
    'Dystopia_17': 'float'
})

# Output path for the target CSV
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_83/target_multisource_cot.csv"

# Write the transformed dataframe to CSV
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
